name: Scale-Adaptive IQL (BC -> IQL Curriculum)
tagline: IQL with safe advantage normalization (std lower-bounded by 1) and a cosine-warmup beta from 0.01 -> 3.0 over 200k steps; expectile tau auto-set to 0.9 on cloned datasets.
formula:
$$L_V = \mathrm{Exp}_\tau(Q_{\text{tgt}} - V),\ \tau = 0.9\text{ if cloned else }0.8$$
$$L_Q = \mathrm{MSE}\bigl(Q,\, r+(1-d)\gamma V(s')\bigr)$$
$$\hat{A} = \frac{A - \bar{A}}{\max(\mathrm{std}(A), 1.0)},\ \beta_t = 0.01 + \tfrac{1}{2}(3-0.01)(1-\cos(\pi\,\min(t/T,1)))$$
$$L_\pi = -\mathbb{E}\bigl[\log\pi(a|s)\,\min(e^{\beta_t \hat{A}},\,100)\bigr]$$

key_hyperparams.name: adv_min_std
key_hyperparams.role: lower bound on adv std for normalization

init_recovers: Approximately BC at t=0; standard IQL after warmup
diff_from_baseline: Two changes vs the iql baseline: a safe (std-lower-bounded) per-batch advantage normalization, and a cosine BC->IQL beta curriculum from 0.01 to 3.0 over 200k steps; per-env iql_tau is bumped to 0.9 on cloned datasets.

name: IQL + Critic-BC + Actor-BC Hybrid
tagline: IQL value/critic/actor losses augmented with a ReBRAC-style critic BC penalty in the Bellman target and an MSE BC term on the deterministic actor; per-env (tau, beta, bc_coef) presets.
formula:
$$L_V = \mathrm{Exp}_{\tau}(Q_{\min}^{\text{tgt}} - V),\ Q_{\min}^{\text{tgt}}=\min(Q_1^{\text{tgt}},Q_2^{\text{tgt}})$$
$$y = r + (1-d)\gamma\bigl(V(s') - \lambda_{\text{cbc}}\,\Vert\pi_\theta^{-}(s') - a'\Vert_2^{2}\bigr)$$
$$L_Q = \mathrm{MSE}(Q_1, y) + \mathrm{MSE}(Q_2, y)$$
$$L_\pi = -\mathbb{E}\bigl[\log\pi(a|s)\,e^{\beta(Q_{\min}^{\text{tgt}}-V)}\bigr] + \lambda_{\text{abc}}\,\Vert\pi_\theta^{\text{det}}(s) - a\Vert_2^{2}$$
diff_from_baseline: Combines iql baseline (V expectile, Q Bellman, AWR actor) with a ReBRAC-style critic BC penalty (-lambda*||pi_target(s')-a'||^2) baked into the Bellman target, and an additional MSE BC term on the deterministic actor; per-env hyperparameters set differently for pen, hammer, and door.

name: Manifold-Augmented Deterministic IQL
tagline: Deterministic-actor IQL with state/action Gaussian augmentation: V/Q losses fit on the union of clean and noised batches; AWR-MSE actor loss averaged over both views, no advantage standardization.
init_recovers: Awac/IQL-style AWR with deterministic MSE actor when sigma_s=sigma_a=0
diff_from_baseline: Compared to iql/awac baselines: deterministic actor optimized by AWR-MSE rather than log-prob; state and action Gaussian augmentation doubles the V/Q batch and mixes clean+noised actor MSE; explicit removal of per-batch advantage standardization (commented out).
